title: Habit Stacking & Anchoring
hook: You already make coffee every morning without thinking. Use that.
statement: Attach new habits to things you already do on autopilot.
explainer: Starting a habit from scratch needs a reminder and willpower. Hooking it onto something you already do daily gives it a ready-made trigger.
sop: List things you already do daily: coffee, shower, commute, closing the laptop.
Count each one's Anchor Freq per week and score its Ease from 1 to 10.
Attach one tiny new habit right after your strongest anchor.
Keep it small until it runs on autopilot.
Then use the same anchor for the next habit.
equation_example: Anchor Freq is 7 times a week, Ease is 9. 7 × 9 = 63. Higher means the new habit has a solid base to stick to. Lower means the anchor itself is too shaky to build on.
question: Pick one thing you do every single day and name the tiny habit you'll attach to it.
closing_statement: Attach new habits to what already runs on autopilot.
